candidate.name: MarginalCategoricalPosteriorV2
candidate.motivation: Replace non-transferable per-class learned parameters with a two-parameter rule that remains defined for source-fold-unseen classes, and align training rows with the frozen 19-class evaluation support.
candidate.input: raw positive class cosine for all 19 classes
candidate.target_blind_scene_statistics: per-class mean and population standard deviation over every valid scene row
candidate.calibration: blend raw, class-centered, and class-standardized scores with one globally shared tanh-bounded centering strength and one globally shared tanh-bounded scaling strength
candidate.initialization: both strengths zero, giving exact raw-score logits and argmax

source_supervision.target: official soft semantic distribution renormalized over the frozen 19 evaluation classes
source_supervision.ignored_rows: rows with zero official mass in the 19 evaluation classes
source_supervision.weight: valid times training-label-weight times coverage times sqrt(resultant_length times evidence_saturation) times foreground_mass, followed by fit-scene class balancing

frozen_gate.pass_rule: all three per-fold checks and both macro checks pass
frozen_gate.on_fail: reject candidate; do not fit all three source scenes and do not open paper-eight labels
frozen_gate.on_pass: fit the identical recipe on all three source scenes, freeze one checkpoint, then evaluate the paper-eight ScanNet OVS cohort once

forbidden: paper-eight label or metric access before source LOSO passes
